score.semantics: Relative ranking score only. Component outputs are classifier scores, not calibrated real-world probabilities.

scoreSemantics: Ranking scores only; no probability/calibration claim.

selection.perTimestamp: At each entry timestamp, for each symbol keep only the higher-score direction if LONG-vs-SHORT score margin >= 0.03. Rank remaining symbol winners by score and select the top 3.
selection.rationale: This prevents the zero-selection failure mode while forcing cross-sectional competition and preserving a measurable opportunity-recall budget.
